items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is 'playing both sides' of AI with Hugging Face purchase
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is buying AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion in a move that could extend Nvidia's reach in the AI ecosystem beyond being just a chip supplier. Futurum CEO Daniel Newman reacts to this headline news and what the acquisition of Hugging Face represents for Nvidia's growing market share of the AI landscape.
